title: The Casual Vacancy
author: J.K. Rowling
summary: When a well-liked councillor dies suddenly in the English village of Pagford, a fight over his empty seat exposes the rivalries, hypocrisies and hidden troubles of its residents and their teenage children.
readIf: you like sharp, unsentimental village portraits with a large cast of flawed people.
skipIf: you are hoping for magic or a light, comforting read like the author's wizard books.
